title: Florida Department of Revenue
purpose: Home page of Florida's state tax agency, with links to all state taxes, forms and online services.
notes: Root domain floridarevenue.com confirmed as official (many official-result pages on it); the bare homepage URL itself did not appear as a search result. Taxes section index https://floridarevenue.com/taxes is an alternative.

title: eServices for Taxes, Fees and Other State Remittances
purpose: Florida DOR's online services hub to register, file and pay state taxes, update accounts and print resale certificates.
notes: DOR is migrating tax types to a new eFile and Pay system in phases (sales tax Dec 2025, reemployment Aug 2026); see eFile and Pay Information Center https://floridarevenue.com/taxes/filepayinfo/Pages/dash.aspx (official-result). Card payments use a third-party vendor per DOR.

title: Individual income tax
notes: Florida does not impose a personal (individual) income tax.

title: Florida Corporate Income Tax
purpose: Explains Florida's corporate income/franchise tax, who must file (Form F-1120), and how to file and pay.
notes: Tax name: Florida Corporate Income/Franchise Tax. Online filing login: https://taxapps.floridarevenue.com/Corporate/Login.aspx (official-result).

title: Florida Sales and Use Tax
purpose: Explains Florida sales and use tax, dealer registration, and filing of Form DR-15.
notes: Includes discretionary sales surtax information (separate page /taxes/taxesfees/Pages/discretionary.aspx).

title: State income tax withholding
notes: Florida has no individual income tax, so there is no state income-tax withholding for employers. Employers still owe Florida reemployment (unemployment) tax.

title: Florida Reemployment Tax
purpose: Explains Florida's employer-paid reemployment (unemployment) tax, quarterly RT-6 reporting and payment.
agency: Florida Department of Revenue (administers reemployment tax for FloridaCommerce)
notes: In Florida the Department of Revenue, not the labor agency, collects reemployment tax. eFile and Pay login: https://floridarevenue.com/taxes/eservices/Pages/rtlogin.aspx (official-result); moved to new system Aug 24, 2026 per DOR.

title: Start a Business - Division of Corporations (Sunbiz)
purpose: Florida Department of State page for forming corporations, LLCs, partnerships and other entities online or by paper form.
agency: Florida Department of State, Division of Corporations
notes: sunbiz.org is the Division of Corporations' official site; content now hosted at dos.fl.gov/sunbiz.

title: File Annual Report - Division of Corporations
purpose: Where Florida corporations, LLCs, partnerships and nonprofits file their required annual report.
agency: Florida Department of State, Division of Corporations
notes: Filing application: https://services.sunbiz.org/Filings/AnnualReport/FilingStart (official-result). Division warns against third-party solicitations.

title: What Services Require a DBPR License?
purpose: Florida DBPR page listing the professions and businesses that need a state license from DBPR.
agency: Florida Department of Business and Professional Regulation
notes: URL is an official result, but this is occupational licensing, not a general business license. Florida state sources (DOS startup guidance) direct businesses to county/city local business tax receipts; no explicit official statement that there is no general statewide license was found.

title: Division of Alcoholic Beverages and Tobacco
purpose: Florida agency that issues licenses and permits to manufacture, distribute or sell alcoholic beverages.
agency: Florida DBPR, Division of Alcoholic Beverages and Tobacco
notes: Division home page (licensing, forms, renewals).

title: Alcoholic beverage excise tax (Division of AB&T)
purpose: Manufacturers, distributors and importers file monthly alcoholic beverage excise tax reports with the Division of Alcoholic Beverages and Tobacco.
agency: Florida DBPR, Division of Alcoholic Beverages and Tobacco
notes: Paid to the ABT division (not DOR). Forms page is an official result, but no dedicated excise-tax web page was confirmed; excise report forms are PDFs on the same site (e.g. /abt/documents/AlcoholicBeverageDistirbutorsMonthlyExciseTaxReport_000.pdf).

title: Articles of Incorporation for Florida Nonprofit Corporation
purpose: Online filing to form a Florida nonprofit corporation with the Division of Corporations.
agency: Florida Department of State, Division of Corporations
notes: Help page: https://efile.sunbiz.org/nonprofit_filing_help.html (official-result).

title: Solicitation of Contributions
purpose: Registration and annual renewal for charities, sponsors and professional solicitors that solicit donations in Florida.
agency: Florida Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services
notes: Under the Solicitation of Contributions Act (Ch. 496, F.S.).

title: Georgia Department of Revenue
purpose: Home page of Georgia's state tax agency, covering income, sales, withholding, alcohol and other state taxes.
notes: Appeared as result (with trailing-dot host variant dor.georgia.gov.).

title: Georgia Tax Center (GTC)
purpose: Georgia DOR's online portal to register, file and pay state taxes and manage individual and business tax accounts.
notes: Help: https://dor.georgia.gov/taxes/help-georgia-tax-center (official-result).

title: Filing Georgia State Individual Income Tax Return
purpose: Explains how Georgia residents and nonresidents file their state individual income tax return.
notes: Forms: https://dor.georgia.gov/taxes/years-individual-income-tax-forms (official-result).

title: Taxes for Corporations
purpose: Explains Georgia corporate income tax and corporate net worth tax filing for corporations.
notes: Tax names: Corporate Income Tax and Net Worth Tax (both on Form 600).

title: Sales & Use Tax
purpose: Explains Georgia sales and use tax registration, rates, filing and payment.
notes: File & Pay page: https://dor.georgia.gov/taxes/business-taxes/sales-use-tax/file-pay (official-result).

title: Withholding Tax (for Employers)
purpose: Explains Georgia employer income-tax withholding registration, returns (G-7) and annual reconciliation.

title: GDOL Employer Portal
purpose: Georgia Department of Labor portal where employers file quarterly unemployment insurance tax and wage reports and pay UI tax.
notes: Info page about the portal (links to login). GDOL plans to replace it with UI Inspire (https://dol.georgia.gov/ui-inspire); launch timing unclear.

title: Corporations Division, Georgia Secretary of State
purpose: Georgia Secretary of State division that handles formation and filings for corporations, LLCs, partnerships and nonprofits.
agency: Georgia Secretary of State, Corporations Division
notes: Online filing system is eCorp (ecorp.sos.ga.gov). How-to: https://sos.ga.gov/how-to-guide/how-guide-register-domestic-entity (official-result).

title: One Click Annual Registration
purpose: Where Georgia business entities file their required annual registration with the Secretary of State.
agency: Georgia Secretary of State, Corporations Division
notes: One Click is for filings with no changes; changes are filed through eCorp online services.

title: No general statewide business license
agency: Georgia Secretary of State (First Stop Business Information Center)
notes: No general statewide business license; licenses are issued by local governments or by occupation. Georgia's First Stop business guide states business licenses are obtained from the county and/or city, with some occupations licensed by the state.

title: Apply for a License to Sell Alcohol
purpose: Explains Georgia state alcohol license types and how to apply through the Georgia Tax Center.
agency: Georgia Department of Revenue, Alcohol & Tobacco Division
notes: Retail licenses require a local license as well (centralized licensing).

title: Alcohol Excise Taxes
purpose: Explains Georgia alcohol excise taxes, which wholesalers and other licensees report and pay to the Department of Revenue.
agency: Georgia Department of Revenue, Alcohol & Tobacco Division
notes: Paid to DOR; excise returns filed through the Georgia Tax Center.

title: Filing Procedure - Corporation (profit and nonprofit)
purpose: Georgia Secretary of State instructions for filing articles of incorporation, including for nonprofit corporations.
agency: Georgia Secretary of State, Corporations Division
notes: PDF instructions (2025 revision). Online filing via eCorp (ecorp.sos.ga.gov).

title: How-To Guide: Charities
purpose: Explains how charitable organizations register with the Georgia Secretary of State before soliciting in Georgia.
agency: Georgia Secretary of State, Charities Division
notes: Under the Georgia Charitable Solicitations Act of 1988.
